title: Pay Per Lead for Jewelers
description: CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers and appraisers. First 3 leads free, then $40 per accepted lead, starting in Atlanta.
html:
Pay Per Lead for Jewelers

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers who want customers looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first 3 leads are free, then each accepted lead costs $40.

How the Pay-Per-Lead Model Works

You pay $40 only for leads you accept, after the first 3 free leads.

What You Get with CaratBase

  • Local leads – Starting with the Atlanta metro, with other regions planned.
  • Optional Pro website widget – $12/month; free widgets are also available.

FAQ

How many free leads can I try? The first 3 leads are free.

What happens after the free leads? Each accepted lead costs $40. You are billed only for leads you accept.

Can I add a widget to my site? Yes. Free widgets (ring sizer, diamond size chart, gold calculator) are on the widgets page, and the Pro widget is $12/month.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
